Name: Pac-Man Fruit Ghosts for Ridgeside RSV
Author: cryomancer199x
Description:
This relatively simple mod adds 8 more fruit ghosts (and pac-pets) to my [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/24869]Pac-Man Fruit Ghosts[/url] mod. These ones produce items from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7286]Ridgeside Village[/url], covering all the fruit trees and several forage items (as deluxe produce). The graphics are edited from Pac-Man Arrangement (1996). Sprites were ripped by Techokami on Spriter's Resource.

You will need those two mods for this one to work. If you have the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1538]Animal Husbandry[/url] addon for fruit ghosts, they'll work with that too.﻿

These ones do not reproduce, no baby textures. Mostly because I was lazy but also because some of these ghosts are already children anyway so it seemed weird.

Transparent variants for the ghosts are also included, even though Sourpuss and Chomp-Chomp don't really make sense, but oh well it's there if you'd like it. Just replace the main folder copies with the transparent folder ones.

Not super extensively tested so let me know if you encounter issues.

Groovy I kind of made up, she's based on the dancing ghosts from Pac & Pal.
